            } else {

                if w.starts_with('+') || w.starts_with('-') {
                    w.parse().ok().map(|delta: i16| {
                        let old_width: u16 = Term::stdout().size().1;
                        let new_width: i32 = i32::from(old_width) + i32::from(delta);

                        if new_width <= 0 {
                            old_width as usize
                        } else {
                            new_width as usize
                        }
                    })
                } else {
                    w.parse().ok()
                }
            })
            .unwrap_or(Term::stdout().size().1 as usize);

            || matches.value_of("color") == Some("always")
            || matches.value_of("decorations") == Some("always"));

            .value_of("tabs")
            .map(String::from)
            .or_else(|| env::var("BAT_TABS").ok())

                    .iter()

                } else {

            .value_of("theme")
            .map(String::from)

                .values_of("line-range")

        .unwrap_or_else(|| vec![]);

            .iter()
            .map(|range| range.upper)
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(usize::max_value());
        let ranges = range_list
            .into_iter()
            .map(|range| LineRange {
                lower: range.lower,
                upper: range.upper,
            })
            .collect();
        let line_ranges = LineRanges {
            ranges,
            largest_upper_bound,
        };
        config.line_ranges = LineRanges {
            ranges: line_ranges.ranges,

            _ => false,
